raw_prompt: Implement user password reset with active session token revocation and fail-closed token validation in `target_module.py`.

semantic_requirements.title: Password Reset Session Revocation
semantic_requirements.description: Invalidate all active sessions and refresh tokens upon password reset.

semantic_requirements.title: Cross-Cluster Token Blacklist Propagation
semantic_requirements.description: Propagate revoked token identifiers across all active cluster nodes.
why_chain: Prompt mandates blacklisting across all clusters

semantic_requirements.title: Cryptographic Credential Hashing (Argon2id / bcrypt)
semantic_requirements.description: IF local credential storage is configured: Hash and salt user passwords using Argon2id or bcrypt.
why_chain: Local credential stores risk database exfiltration
Argon2id memory-hard hashing prevents brute force attacks

semantic_requirements.title: Bounded Blacklist Retention and TTL Expiry
semantic_requirements.description: Retain revoked token entries in the blacklist for the maximum token TTL window.
why_chain: Expired tokens cannot be accepted anyway

semantic_requirements.title: Immediate Fail-Closed Access Gate
semantic_requirements.description: Reject requests with blacklisted tokens immediately with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
why_chain: Revoked credentials must not execute privileged operations
Fail-closed gateway validates blacklist on every call

semantic_requirements.title: Underlying Storage Technology Specification
semantic_requirements.description: The specific persistence engine and database backend are unstated in prompt.
why_chain: Prompt does not specify database technology

semantic_requirements.title: API Transport Protocol Specification
semantic_requirements.description: The specific network transport protocol (gRPC vs REST) is unstated in prompt.
why_chain: Prompt does not specify API protocol
